api_key.title: newsapi.ai API key
api_key.description: Your API key from https://newsapi.ai/dashboard. Stored in the system's secure credential store. Leave empty to use the NEWSAPI_AI_KEY environment variable or ~/.config/newsapi-ai-mcp/config.json instead.

max_days.title: Limit searches to recent news
max_days.description: Never query older data than this. 31 or 7 days avoid the more expensive archive searches; 'off' allows the full archive.
